author: KizzyFizzy
body:
Hello!  My name is Mala, or you can go by my real name, Kizzy. I am 21 Years old, I live in Iowa, so this is a Central Time Zone, I have access to Skype, Team Speak, and Discord, I hardly Skype or TeamSpeak your best bet is Discord, I do have access to a recording software. 

CRITERIA 1: SELF-REFLECTION/EVALUATION

Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers?
I do not have experience in being a staff member.

What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating?
My biggest weakness would be that I am a sensitive person, but there's force to it because I have the compassion to help.  My biggest strengths are that I am nice and easy to get along with.


How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team?
Teamwork and communication are my top priority to help improve the team.

What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why?
Qualities a leader need is communication with other. I would say I am a half leader and follower 50/50!

What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?  
I am very friendly to others and willing to help out if there is a problem.


What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?
Being polite, friendly, helpful, alert. I believe I have these skills greatly


How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)? 
Because I have a job in my life and am a part of a club  I work Tuesday and Thursdays only and then attend to my club  but I have Monday, Wednesday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday off. 
Unless something comes up I will be quick to let people know why I will not be attending.


CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS

You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly banned evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do?
I would be quick to contact a Moderator or other staff member (higher than jr mod)


Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on Teamspeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be on that channel. However, the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked them to leave multiple times. What would you do?
I would politely message them explaining as to why they can't be there at the moment.


A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realize that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do?
I would ask if someone else had evidence, but if there were no way to get that, then I would hold off on appealing them from the punishment if I had known of the infraction and had discussed with others about the situation to try to resolve it.

You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Amicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?
I would ask them to take the post down just to respect others. If the post wasn't taken down, I would ask others if I should remove it to make sure.


One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However, you do not like the decision based on what you know. What would you do?
If this had happened, I would simply talk about it to a staff member, but I would back off if there were no choice to swing the opinion.



CRITERIA 3: OTHER

What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you?
Getting moderator would mean greatly to me because I love to help people with their problems especially in my real life I am always reaching out to people, it's a weakness but a strength at the same time.


How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you?
Avicus means family to me mainly because of the people that I bond with and to be honest its the only server I'll visit first without hesitating 

Do you speak any other languages than English?
I lived overseas in Honduras for five years  at age 8 I speak Spanish but I have lost some of it because I haven't put it in use. 


Do you have anything else to add to your application?

I thank people who are reading this over!
